static_design.implementation: Each SIMD lane caches four packed uint16 words and one scale per output row/K512 step, reusing them across T2/4/5; original per-lane accumulation, qdot expression, simd_sum and BF16 store order retained in source. Compiler equivalence is not established by source reading.
static_design.original_operands: Original uint32 W and uint8 scales; canonical observed GPU strides required; no helper copies/repack or parameter rebind.
static_design.geometry: 64 threads, 2 SIMD groups, 4 output rows per SIMD; exact 9 N/K geometries, T2/4/5 only.
static_design.route: Default OFF router; geometry/input-layout ineligibility routes to old113 fallback, while runtime/quantization/prepare/compile errors propagate. Required local M4 matrix route was shared124 without fallback.
static_design.performance_limitation: The historical router prepares a new object on every call, so each local probe rebuilds its kernel wrapper. Prepared/kernel caching is only a future plan. Register reuse can reduce occupancy; source reuse does not imply speedup.

m5_transfer_limits: Frozen helper explicitly requires MLX0.32.3 + Apple M4 Max/applegpu_g16s; it is intentionally not an M5 callable route. Do not remove guard and claim qualification.

Five historical dependency originals retain source-machine identity only; weights/runtime/compiler/original absolute P-directory layout are not bundled. Source verification is not a portable GPU replay.

M5 needs a new source-pinned default-OFF adapter and fresh local compiler/runtime/actual GPU shape-stride evidence, then complete original-dtype finite/byte equality to native M1 for all supported geometry/T and original-operand readonly checks. No such work was performed here.

Before adoption, independently qualify propagated full-model state/raw IDs and then unobserved paired HTTP throughput-versus-complete-request-latency under valid resource admission. M4 same-input local checks cannot qualify M5 or confer performance.
